description: Fetch one public web page in a sandboxed browser and return its title and visible text (up to 18,000 characters). Use find to get only the lines you need and maxChars to cap the size; links are listed only with includeLinks. Set javascript for pages that need it (runs only where Rove has enabled it). Optionally include a PNG screenshot.

find.description: Only return lines containing any of these words or phrases (case-insensitive), with one line of context each.

includeLinks.description: Also list links (extract) or the pages visited (runs). Off by default to keep results short.

includeScreenshot.description: Also return the PNG screenshot as an image

javascript.description: Render with JavaScript (only on hosts Rove has enabled; the result mode says what ran)

maxChars.description: Return at most this many characters of the answer/page text (200-100000). The result says truncated and totalChars when it was cut.

name: rove_extract

hint.description: What to do next, in plain words

linkCount.description: Links found on the page (listed only with includeLinks)

matches.description: Matching lines, when find was given

pageTruncated.description: Rove kept only the first 18,000 characters of a longer page

retryAfterSec.description: Seconds to wait before calling again

shownChars.description: Characters returned in the text content

status.description: completed, partial, running, waiting, failed, … or error

totalChars.description: Characters in the full answer or page text

truncated.description: True when maxChars cut the text short

title: Extract a public web page
